judgment.notes: A001 instantiates E005 with f=S_(-n*tau)u^n and q=u^n. Smoothness and mean zero follow by the finite-step invariant proved in S001; tau>0 and n>=0 are the quantified local conditions. The source contract already uses precisely D004 and D008-D012, so no unstated source conversion is needed.

S001 proves the invariant from the smooth real mean-zero base datum: P and outer inverse derivatives kill the means of the nonlinear terms, while the scalar-mean term contains S_tau Dinv f. At each step E005 gives F001. At the right endpoint Q_n-W_n=-R2, giving the next twisted iterate; at the left all time integrals vanish. Differentiation gives V_n'=B_t(z_n,z_n)/2-W_n/tau. Symmetry and bilinearity of B_t then give the stated residual using V_n=z_n+Y_n. Endpoint agreement proves continuity, and adding the zero-based rho_n increments constructs Rres with Rres(0)=0. Smoothness and differentiation are justified by BG001-BG002.

The only substantive imported statement is the direct premise E005. F001 is established in S001 before use in S002. The notation F_n,C_n,Q_n,W_n,z_n,Y_n,rho_n is supplied by D019; f and v are constructed from the recursively defined iterates. The type of f is justified by the invariant, not assumed from its declaration. Initial datum, positive tau and arbitrary step index remain within their quantified scopes, and the finite recurrence uses its earlier iterate only. There is no escaped witness, extra H, future fact or producer-body dependence.
